features.title: Your playlists, together
features.description: Paste your provider’s details to fill the form, or connect with Xtream Codes, an M3U link or a local playlist file. Keep multiple profiles on your device.

features.title: A full TV guide
features.description: Load XMLTV schedules, fix unmatched channels, shift a guide that runs early or late, and use catch-up when your provider supports it.

features.title: Movies and series
features.description: Browse your provider’s library, choose seasons and continue with the next episode.

features.title: Favorites, lists and history
features.description: Save channels, build your own lists, hide titles you never watch and resume where you left off.

features.title: Playback your way
features.description: Adjust playback over the video, choose supported player options and set a sleep timer.

features.title: Take your settings with you
features.description: Export and import an encrypted backup of profiles and preferences. Use family controls for protected categories.

changes: Faster, ranked search: exact names first, then names that start with what you typed.
Your own lists, hidden titles, and series shown latest-first or unwatched-only, with autoplay of the next episode.
Guide repair: suggested channel matches, a health summary, per-guide time offsets and recent history.
Previous channel, return to live, and audio and subtitles that follow your preferred language.
Paste your provider details to set up in seconds. Backups now carry lists and new preferences, and import lets you add or update.
Native navigation, sheets and press feedback across the app.
Existing playlists, profiles, signing and identifiers are retained; 0.7.x backups still import.
